description: Ask the anchor agent of one place (a shop or any other place on the map) a question in any language, e.g. hours, menu, prices. It answers only from notes people wrote; notes the owner did not confirm are attributed to their writer. When the notes do not cover the question it says so and records the question for someone to answer. It cannot take orders, bookings or payments. No key needed. Get place ids from jic_anchors.

anchor.description: Anchor id from jic_anchors or jic_map_places, e.g. biz:27dc82c669e3 or church:Q2942399

name: jic_anchor_ask
title: Ask the agent of an anchor
